Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics data (PXD017585) is described as an affinity purification (streptavidin pulldown) to identify MIR222HG-interacting proteins. While the overall study focuses on serum-induced cell cycle reentry, the MS experiment specifically identifies the interactome of the spliced MIR222HG lncRNA. The primary biological variables extracted reflect the overarching experimental design (serum starvation vs stimulation) that defines the biological states of the cells used for the proteomics analysis.
